about.title: Brothers Brian and Blaine
paragraphs: B & B Automotive is run by brothers Brian and Blaine, and Honda owners around Washougal have trusted them with their cars for years.
They're also a go-to shop for the classic 1970s Honda 600, with parts and know-how that are hard to find anywhere else.
about.photo_alt: Mechanic reaching into an engine bay

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Brian or Blaine will get back to you. Or call (360) 835-5191 (Mon–Fri: 8am–5:30pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Brian or Blaine will get back to you soon to set up a time.
